data.name: Roby
data.long_meaning: The name Roby originates from the Greek word 'Robertos', which is derived from the Hebrew name 'Raphael'. It means 'Bright' or 'Famous'. In the Bible, Raphael is one of the archangels who healed Tobias and Sarah during their journey. The name Roby symbolizes courage, strength, and healing.

This name is a reminder to always shine brightly, even in the darkest of times, and to never lose sight of one's inner radiance.

It is a reminder of the power of God to bring healing and restoration to those who are in need. Additionally, the name Roby encourages courage and strength, as seen in the Biblical account of Raphael's healing of Tobias and Sarah during their journey.
